terra.problem: The four moments from 1 and 2 Kings concern the town of Jezreel or nearby property, not explicitly the Valley of Jezreel. The town was on the valley’s edge. Distinguish the town from the valley, or place those moments on a separate town card.

In “Jehu strikes down Joram,” “Jehu shot him, as the LORD had said would happen” suggests the LORD foretold the shooting. The passage instead recalls the LORD’s promise to repay Ahab on Naboth’s plot of ground.
